text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One evening, while accompanying Biko Pegasus on her patrol—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm! What's all that racket?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! A lottery raffle!
Whoa, check it out—they've got luxury prizes!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Just a quick try, okay?
Rattling that lottery wheel is so exciting, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“Looks like you need raffle tickets, though.
I don't plan on shopping, so I'll pass this time...”

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Biko-chan, do you want lottery tickets?
Granny has one spare supplement ticket, you know.
You can spin once if you gather five, so here you go.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman B
text_block_list.text:
I have some extra tickets, too. It'd be a waste not to use them,
so please, take them if you'd like.
Consider it thanks for your usual patrols!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Here's mine too.
Thanks for helping out at the shop the other day.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I gathered 5 of them in no time!
Thanks, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to combine all 5 feelings!!
Let's go! Lend me a hand, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaah!!
Pegasus Lucky Fortune!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After striking a pose together,
we turned the raffle crank at the same time!
The result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: W-WHAT THE HECK—!!!???

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! Amazing!
It's the grand prize~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Table tennis! Arcade games! Pillow fights!!
Heheh, I can't wait~♪"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hold onto this hot spring ticket for me! I'm not ready to go just yet!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan, you're working so hard on your races too! You know it's okay to rest your wings for a bit, right?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No! If anything, my real battle starts now!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm not a superhero like Carrotman yet, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in so many more races
and become a beacon of hope for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer!
If I manage to become a splendid hero—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: When that time comes, let's go to a hot spring together!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want to go with me?
Are you sure you want me to be the one going with you?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Well, of course! You're my fellow hero, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's smiles and peace on Earth!
We're gonna celebrate protecting them together!
choice_data_list: Got it! It's a promise, then.
Got it! It's a promise, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! To become a splendid hero...
I'll sprint toward tomorrowww!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be everyone's hero."
Watching her back burn with that passion,
emotions welled up inside me as I looked on.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Looks delicious!
Let's have this for dinner tonight!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I love hamburger steaks!
I could eat tons of this.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
That's great, Biko-chan.
Oh, but you can't just eat meat; you need your veggies too. I bought too many, so let me share some with you.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No, I'd feel bad just taking stuff from you.
Besides, my meal comes with a side of veggies, so I'm good!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Every feast needs dessert, doesn't it?
I'll buy you a carrot manju~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait! You gotta have white rice with Salisbury steak~!
I'll share some delicious freshly harvested rice with you.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, jeez!
I can't eat that muchーーー!

text_block_list.name: Everyone from the Shopping District
text_block_list.text: Ahahahahaha—!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the thought to heart!
Thanks, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The adults in the shopping district just couldn't resist doting on Biko Pegasus...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So many!
That's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Can I eat it all...?
Hehehe, I'll go make something with Bono!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Roasted carrots, carrot glacé,
carrot rapées, and then, and then~...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Something with a long shelf life... right!
Because there's way too much of it otherwise...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We need an "operation" so this doesn't go bad!
Commander <username>!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Emergency strategy meeting! We're gonna come up with a massive consumption plan!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"And make sure you help me eat it too!
We'll combine our strength and finish every delicious bite!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later... Our operation was a resounding success!
She ate much more than usual and was fully energized!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A carrot... Just one, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“Wait, huh...?
This carrot... hey, take a look at this!”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! What an interesting shape!
Doesn't it kinda look like a pistol?
choice_data_list: You're right. It's kind of bent...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I can fire off carotene power!
Let me borrow that for a sec—!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I shall name it the 'Carrot Gun'!
Beams shoot out from here! Pew-pew-pew-pew-pew!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Wait, wait, that wasn't an attack!
Whoever gets shot gets fully recharged with energy!
Let's do a redo!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She took quite a liking to the Carrot Gun,
firing "Nutritional Beams" over and over.
Apparently, they roasted the carrot and ate it later.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Dammit, just pocket tissues, huh...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What a shame... But heroes are usually down on their luck in everyday life, right...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus said so,
though her ears drooped all the same...
